page.layout: One column of running text with Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee lemmata; the Hebrew roots hang in the left margin beside their entries; a catchword at the lower right. Printed page 348 at the head, running head "JOH. BUXTORFII JUN.".

main_text.p: רָחַל[?], ab innocetia. Act.8.32. Plur. [Syriac plural form, illegible, ~6 letters] Pasce mihi oviculas meas, Johan.21.17.

נִקְטוּCh.Molestum, tædiosum esse: Molestiâ, tædio afficere, affligere: Item Capere, accipere, tenere, retinere, Esth.5.2. & 8.15. Aphel אַנְקִיטIdé: וְאַנְקִיטוּEt tenuerunt, Esth.4.16. in Targ. sec. Ex Pahel Futur. תְּנַקְּטוּןAffligetis, Jobi 19.2.
נִקְלִיןCh.Postes, vectes, asferes, Esth.1.6. Asferes proprie lecti inferiores.
נְקַםCh. Ulcísci, vindicare, Levit.19.18. Ithpahel אִתְנְקַםUlcísci, vindicare se, Exo.21.20. in T.H.
נְקַענִקְעָאSyr. Fossæ, foveæ, lustra, Matth.8.20. Lucæ 9.58.

נְקַףCh.Percutere, contundere, cervicem confringere, decollare: Item Impellere, supplantare, Psal.140.6. Syris est Adhærere, adjungere se alicui, contrectare. Ex Pahel Futur. Ch. יִנְקְפִנֵּיהּImpellet eum, Psal.140.12. Syr. [Syriac, illegible, ~5 letters]Adhærebant ei, vel Cinxerunt, Circumdederunt eum, ut Reg. & Tremel. reddunt, Matth.8.1. & sic idem esset, quod יִקַּף. Ex Ethpah. Part. [Syriac, illegible, ~6 letters]Adjungite vos bono, ad Rom.12.9. Infinit. [Syriac, illegible, ~5 letters]Adjungere se, Act.9.26. Ex Aphel Præt. [Syriac, illegible, ~4 letters]Et adjunxerunt sibi, Act.17.5.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee forms are given as best read from the scan; the vowel points and Syriac letters are uncertain and are not reliably rendered. Entries printed in the left margin are treated as lemmata beside their entries. The lower-right word נקץ is a catchword.
